ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New work, Terms agreed and later stages need Amount, Billing model and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_work", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Conflict check", 3, "Proposal", 4, "Proposal sent", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Engagement letter out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 6, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_model__c)), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Billing model and Close date before moving to Terms agreed.
